description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

Many of our teams work alongside customers around the world, so travel, corporate spend, and stipends have to run smoothly. Today, travel and expense is handled by someone who is also carrying other responsibilities, and as spend and travel have grown, it has become more than a side responsibility.

We’re hiring a dedicated T&E Analyst to own it end to end. You’ll make sure every expense is reviewed, coded to the right department and GL account, and in policy, and you’ll be the first line of review for out-of-policy travel. That keeps Finance confident at month-end close and gives employees fast, clear answers.

This role also has room to grow. Beyond keeping the process clean, you’ll look for anomalies, strengthen our controls, and spot opportunities to consolidate spend into enterprise agreements that save the company money. You’ll report to the Manager, Financial Operations, and this is a strong path into a broader financial operations career.

What You’ll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Own review of corporate card expenses and employee reimbursements, ensuring each is in policy and coded accurately to the right department and GL account

  • Serve as the first line of review for out-of-policy travel, working with travelers and managers to resolve exceptions

  • Administer the home office stipend and other employee stipends, including reviewing and approving requests and coding the associated expenses

  • Monitor travel and expense spend for anomalies and policy exceptions, and build reports and analysis that identify trends and savings opportunities, including vendor and enterprise agreement consolidation

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2-3 years of experience in expense management, accounts payable, or financial operations

  • Hands-on experience managing and reviewing corporate expenses in Brex

  • Working knowledge of GL coding and departmental cost allocation

  • Meticulous attention to detail, with the ability to apply expense and travel policy consistently and catch errors or out-of-policy spend

  • Ability to analyze expense data and build clear reports in Excel or Google Sheets

  • Clear, professional communication, including comfort giving employees direct policy feedback while keeping a helpful tone

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Brex or similar corporate credit card platforms

  • Experience with Navan or similar travel management platforms

  • Experience with Compt or similar stipend administration platforms

  • Exposure to vendor consolidation, negotiation, or cost-savings initiatives

  • Familiarity with month-end close and how expense data flows into the accounting process

 
 

Indicators of Success

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful T&E Analyst will:

  • Be the trusted owner of T&E, with expenses reviewed, coded, and approved on time so they never delay month-end close

  • Keep coding accurate and consistent across departments and GL accounts, with minimal rework from Accounting

  • Catch out-of-policy spend and travel exceptions early, and have a repeatable review process in place

  • Provide employees a smooth, responsive experience with reimbursements, stipends, and travel approvals, with clear answers to policy questions

  • Deliver regular T&E reporting that Financial Operations uses, and surface at least one concrete opportunity to consolidate spend into an enterprise agreement

 
 

Tools, Systems & Technologies (Optional)

  • Brex for corporate cards and expense management

  • Navan for travel booking and management

  • Compt for stipend administration

  • Excel / Google Sheets for analysis and reporting


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.
